newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ng Fung Hong buys major stake in fishery.
newsitem.headline: Ng Fung Hong buys major stake in fishery.

text.p: Ng Fung Hong Ltd has agreed to acquire a 51 percent stake in China International Fisheries Corp for US$80.55 million (HK$623.46 million), the company said in an announcement published on Tuesday.
Ng Fung Hong entered into a conditional agreement with CNFC International Fisheries Corp, a subsidiary of a Chinese state enterprise, to acquire China International on Monday, it said.

China International, wholly owned by CNFC, is active in marine fishing, processing, sales, refrigeration, transportation of aquatic products, and production and operation under international cooperative fishing projects, it said.

Under the terms of the deal, CNFC International Fisheries has undertaken that China International Group's audited profits after tax but before extraordinary items for the six months to December 31, 1997, would be not less than US$12.764 million.
It has also undertaken that China International Group's profits would be not less than US$21.882 million for the 1997 year and US$25.164 million for the year to December 1998.
